items.title: PG&E Profit Rises from Lower Costs on Flat Revenue
items.summary: The Oakland, Calif., utility posted a profit of $761 million, or 33 cents a share, compared with $549 million, or 24 cents a share, in the same quarter a year earlier.  Stripping out one-time items, adjusted earnings were 40 cents a share.  Analysts polled by FactSet had been expecting 36 cents a share.
